chronist_01:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: pixel art production card icon sheet for Vibespire. Generate ONE square image, a strictly aligned 4 columns by 4 rows grid of exactly 16 separate illustrations in row-major order. Each equal square cell has a SINGLE centered chunky icon occupying about 70% of the cell, broad clear flat magenta #FF00FF outer margins and full continuous magenta gutters. NO drawn grid lines. Background everywhere flat #FF00FF. Phantasy Star 1987 Sega Master System pixel art: very coarse square pixels, thick pure black outline, flat limited SMS colors, deep navy blue / blue / cyan / white with small gold accents (gold = #FFAA00 or #FFFF55). Target each drawing to read in just 32x24 pixels: broad simple shapes, strong distinct silhouettes, 3 or 4 major color clusters, NO tiny engraving, NO fine texture, NO lettering, NO numerals, NO clock dial numbers, NO faces, NO scenery, NO shadows, NO gradients or antialiasing. Draw each subject distinctly, do not connect cells. All 16 cells must be present. Position list (do not draw these labels):
Row 1, column 1: cyan pulse pistol firing white energy bolt.
Row 1, column 2: deep blue kite shield with gold rim.
Row 1, column 3: short golden clock needle stabbing cyan spark.
Row 1, column 4: blue pendulum shield swinging behind gold pivot.
Row 2, column 1: sharp gold pinion spear piercing blue plate.
Row 2, column 2: paired blue cog blades with gold teeth.
Row 2, column 3: heavy gold mallet striking cyan shockwave.
Row 2, column 4: curved blue harpoon skimming still white wave.
Row 3, column 1: twin offset cyan daggers with gold hilts.
Row 3, column 2: stubby blue naval cannon with gold muzzle.
Row 3, column 3: gold bell clapper striking cyan echo slash.
Row 3, column 4: towering blue tidal claw with white crest.
Row 4, column 1: three gold bell hammers radiating cyan shockwaves.
Row 4, column 2: sealed blue storm bottle shielding white lightning.
Row 4, column 3: closed blue calendar folio with gold clasp.
Row 4, column 4: unrolled cyan star chart with gold dividers.
